name: Dan Williams
role: Medora schoolteacher, later railroad telegraph operator
bio: Dan Williams taught Medora's school at the Cantonment from July 1884 and again from December 1884. In 1885 he also worked as night watchman at the cold-storage house and was appointed agent at Sentinel Butte. By late 1885 he was working as a telegraph operator at Mingusville, and in April 1886 he replaced W. H. Minty as night operator at Medora.

moments.label: Began teaching school at the Cantonment
